text:
Nora: Quick heads-up — scheduling a quiet-window rollout for kernel+quant profile on canary-slice-7 tonight at 23:00 UTC. Estimated ~20m. Need a smoke owner, someone on rollback watch, and one person to run post-smoke perf checks. Core checklist below.

Vik: I can own smoke at 23:00 UTC. Will run health + perf and post results here. Ping me if you need me to start earlier. :thumbsup:

Kelly: I'll be rollback watcher. I’ll have the fallback variant ready and will keep an eye on traces/latency graphs. If anything >10% QPS latency or error spike, I’ll trigger fallback and notify.

Sam: Quick Q — do we need to drain slice before swapping kernel? Also any KV cache invalidation needed for this quant bump?

Nora: Good Q. No full drain required for canary slice (we're doing slice-swap with traffic cutover). Steps: 1) Pause new heavy inferences to the slice (small traffic reroute happens automatically). 2) Clear per-instance KV cache to avoid stale kv-format mismatches: run `curl -X POST http://slice-7-admin/internal/kv/evict` on the owner node. 3) Apply kernel flags and quant profile. 4) Start runtime, run smoke tests. 5) Observe 10m. 6) If green, promote to next slice window.

Vik: Smoke checklist I’ll run (and paste outputs):
- `curl -f https://slice-7.api.redwood.ai/health` (expect 200)
- small perf run: python snippet to generate 100 tiny sequences (attached below)
- tail runtime logs: `kubectl logs -l slice=canary-7 -f --since=5m`

```
# quick perf test
from redwood_client import Client
c = Client(url="https://slice-7.api.redwood.ai", token="$REDWOOD_TEST")
for _ in range(100):
    c.generate("short test")
```

Kelly: For rollback I have the fallback image tag: `redwood/runtime:prod-2026-03-15-fallback`. Rollback steps in brief: `kubectl set image deployment/runtime redwood/runtime=<fallback-tag>` then trigger the KV warmup job. I’ll paste full rollback runbook if we need it.

Sam: Thx. Also confirm telemetry toggles? I want higher sampling on traces for first 10m so we get flamegraphs if something odd happens.

Nora: Yes — enable trace sampling to 100% for slice-7 for the 10m observation window: `deploy-bot: set-trace-sample slice-7 100 --ttl 10m` (deploy-bot will return a confirmation). After 10m revert to 5%.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary-rollout for slice-7 at 2026-11-21T23:00:00Z (owner: Nora). Will run preflight checks 10m before and post-smoke alerts.

Vik: I’ll post smoke outputs here as short snippets. Plan to start preflight at 22:50 UTC (health + small perf) and then kickoff at 23:00.

Kelly: I’ll be on pager standby 22:55–23:30 UTC and will have rollback commands in my terminal. Slack call if any non-clear failures.

Nora: Thanks team. Last ask: if you run into subtle perf regressions, include p50/p95/p99 and a single example input that reproduced the worst-case. If all green, I’ll mark canary complete and schedule next slice. :white_check_mark:
